body:
Flagged ready after a quick pass. The review comes on a ready PR (AGENTS.md).

The full quick gate cannot run on the author's machine: the plan falls back to the whole `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui` sets (766 steps) because the goldens are shared inputs. On our machine the suites that read the changed goldens were run on the merge with `main` `02bf65d93` (clean):

- `camcraft-app --test control_comp`: 9 passed
- `camcraft-app --test wear_comp`: 5 passed
- `camcraft-app --lib`: 307 passed
- `camcraft-motion --test control_comp`: 8 passed
- `camcraft-motion --test wear_comp`: 2 passed
- `camcraft-motion --test contour_start_comp`: 5 passed

`git status --short -- crates/app/tests/golden` is empty with `WRITE_GOLDEN` unset: the committed goldens match the produced output.

The P1 review runs on this head, with the targeted heavy step.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5dbe2228d7586a36e4f1adc394f4414357fb5318 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The code, the pins and the moved goldens are correct. One evidence item is missing from the PR body (item 1). It does not need a code change.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code (eight NC goldens) and the 2D Contour generator.

### What looks good

- `contour_comp::door` refuses a `Linear` lead-in and a `Linear` lead-out under Control and Wear. The refusal names the mode, the end and the two legal options. The refusal comes before any geometry.
- The refusal uses `wanted(p)`, so Control and Wear have the same rule. Computer compensation does not change.
- The issue asks for pins on the posted G-code with an oversized register and a positive wear value. `the_entry_descents_before_g41_hold_the_wall_clear_under_an_oversized_register_and_positive_wear` reads the Fanuc program and does this for Plunge and Arc, Control and Wear. The bore side is pinned on the CL positions. The body gives the reason: no whole-model fixture gives an inside ring.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3891-comp-entry-wall.md` gives what was chosen, why, and what was dropped.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3891`. The commit subject is conventional. There is no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no new dependency, no new test binary and no `unwrap` outside tests.

### Goldens moved (read line by line)

All eight files (`nc/`, `haas/`, `mazak/`, `sinumerik/`, control and wear) have the same change:

- The dive point moves from `X11 Y-3` to `X5 Y-9`. The old point is on the ring offset line (Y-3), 3.16 mm from the corner of the 10 x 10 part. The new point is 9 mm from the wall: the radius 3 plus the lead 6.
- The lead-in `X5 Y-9` -> `X5 Y-3` (wear) or `X5 Y0` (control, programmed contour) is 6 mm long. It is square to the first cut (`X0`, travel in -X).
- The `G40` cancel now ends at `X5 Y-9` (the mirrored Perpendicular lead-out), not at `X-1 Y-3` on the ring line.
- On the second level, one rapid goes away: the retract point and the next dive point are now the same XY point. The Sinumerik block numbers move by 10 for this reason.
- The compensated ring blocks (`G41` ... `G40`) do not change in any file.

`git status` showed no golden change after the suites ran with `WRITE_GOLDEN` unset.

### Results (local, trial merge with `upstream/main` `02bf65d93`, clean merge)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion` all binaries (lib 624 passed, 22 ignored; every suite) | pass, 0 failed |
| app `control_comp` | 9 passed |
| app `wear_comp` | 5 passed |
| app `contour_dxf_sketch`, `golden_cl`, `linuxcnc_post`, `short_arc_lattice` | 4, 34, 9, 2 passed |
| app `--lib` | 307 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 1596 passed, 8 ignored (snapshot lane) |
| ui `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | 3, 7, 2, 2, 3, 3, 17, 1 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| light lane `cargo xtask gate light` (6 steps, release) | 0 failed |

Extra suites run:

- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: 41 passed (4 ignored), 1 passed, 1 passed.
- No file under `testdata/` changed. No importer code changed.

The quick plan has 766 steps, because the goldens are shared inputs. Only `control_comp` and `wear_comp` read the eight changed goldens. This review ran those suites and the suites that set control or wear compensation, not all 766 steps.

Targeted heavy step (P1, safety floor): no `#[ignore]`d test covers `contour_comp.rs` or the comp suites. The heavy step therefore has no test to run.

### Mutations (in the review worktree only, then reverted)

1. The review disabled the new `Lead::Linear` refusal in `door`. Red: `a_linear_lead_under_control_or_wear_is_refused_by_name_on_both_sides` (motion), `every_lead_the_control_cannot_engage_on_is_refused_by_name` (motion), `a_linear_lead_in_or_out_under_control_or_wear_is_refused_and_posts_nothing` (app). The motion output showed the defect: a dive at `(21, -5)` on the radius 5 ring line.
2. With the refusal still disabled, the review set the app fixture lead back to `Linear`. Red: `the_entry_descents_before_g41_hold_the_wall_clear_...` gives "the closest pre-G41 stand is 3.162 mm off the wall". A 5.0 mm register cuts the wall at that point. The posted-G-code pin finds the defect.

Both files were restored. All pins were green again.

### Requested before merge

1. **Before and after screenshots of the Approach page.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/approach_page.rs:229` changes the control-compensation consequence line, which the user sees. The PR body has no screenshots. Add a before and an after image of that line with Control compensation selected. Put the images on an images-only branch and link them from the body. Do not commit them to the PR branch. This is a body change only. The same head can then be reviewed again.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/tests/control_comp.rs` grows from 310 to 495 lines. It is now past the 400-line guide. The #3891 tests and their helpers (`linear_world`, `wall_clear`, `under_g40_stands`) can move to a submodule at a later touch.
- No structural test asserts the new consequence text. A later UI test can pin it.
- A project that was saved with Control or Wear and a Linear lead now refuses at generate. This is the intended safety refusal. The message tells the user what to pick. The `Changelog:` row says so.
- The body can also say "targeted heavy step: none, no heavy test covers the changed code" (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Screenshots for review item 1 are linked from the PR body.

Both images show the Cutter compensation group on the Approach page (Lead in / Lead out tab). The selector reads In control (G41/G42). The lead-in is Linear, 6 mm. This is the state that `a_linear_lead_in_or_out_under_control_or_wear_is_refused_and_posts_nothing` builds.

- Before (parent 6dc848512): the consequence line says "needs straight Linear or Perpendicular leads at least a tool radius long; tabs, corner blends, overlap, keep-down links and non-Fanuc posts are refused by name".
- After (head 5dbe2228d): the line says "needs a Perpendicular lead at least a tool radius long; a Linear lead, tabs, corner blends, overlap, keep-down links and non-Fanuc posts are refused by name".

Capture method: the off-screen guide image harness. The test builds the state with the app commands, opens the Lead in / Lead out tab, and renders the frame with `Harness::render`. Each PNG is a crop of that frame. The crop keeps the compensation selector and the consequence line.

The PNGs are stored on branch `pr-screenshots` of the fork FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft. No code changed on this PR. The head stays 5dbe2228d.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5dbe2228d7586a36e4f1adc394f4414357fb5318 -->
**Verdict: Clean. Ready to merge.** This is a re-review of the same head, `5dbe2228d`. The earlier review asked for one evidence item in the PR body. The body now has it. No code changed.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code (eight NC goldens) and the 2D Contour generator.

### Earlier findings (review of 17:12Z, same head)

1. **Before and after screenshots of the Approach page: fixed.** The body links two images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. No image is on the PR branch.
   - Before (parent `6dc848512`): "needs straight Linear or Perpendicular leads at least a tool radius long; tabs, corner blends, overlap, keep-down links and non-Fanuc posts are refused by name".
   - After (head `5dbe2228d`): "needs a Perpendicular lead at least a tool radius long; a Linear lead, tabs, corner blends, overlap, keep-down links and non-Fanuc posts are refused by name".
   - Each image shows the Cutter compensation group with "In control (G41/G42)" selected. The "after" text is the same as the string in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/approach_page.rs:229`.

### Code and goldens, checked again

- The trial merge is with a newer `upstream/main` (`95e01ce28`; the earlier review used `02bf65d93`). The merge is clean.
- Main added tab-window dive pecking (#3678) in `contour.rs` and `contour_step.rs`. Each peck stays at the same XY point as the dive (`e2`). Thus the clearance at the lead-in start that this PR pins does not change.
- The eight goldens: each removed or added line is one of these:
  - the dive point, `X11 Y-3` -> `X5 Y-9`;
  - the `G40` end point, `X-1 Y-3` -> `X5 Y-9`;
  - the retract rapids at those points;
  - the Sinumerik block numbers, which move by 10 because one rapid goes away.

  No line between `G41` and `G40` changes. `X5 Y-9` is 9 mm from the 10 x 10 part: the radius 3 plus the lead 6. The old point was 3.16 mm from the corner `(10, 0)`.
- `git status` showed no golden change after the suites ran.

### Results (local, trial merge `fbc0b0844` = PR head + `upstream/main` `95e01ce28`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion` all 156 test binaries (lib 629 passed, 22 ignored; `machining2d` 75, `control_comp` 8, `wear_comp` 2, `contour_start_comp` 5, `climb_direction` 9, `contour_tab_*` all) | pass, 0 failed |
| app `--lib` | 307 passed |
| app `control_comp`, `wear_comp` | 9, 5 passed |
| app `golden_cl`, `linuxcnc_post`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `short_arc_lattice` | 34, 9, 4, 2 passed |
| ui `--lib` | 1608 passed, 8 ignored (snapshot lane) |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| light lane `cargo xtask gate light` (6 steps, release) | 0 failed |
| app `plunge_depth_tab` | 1 failed: **also red on bare `upstream/main` `95e01ce28`**, see below |

Extra suites run:

- `app suites: example_catalog` 41 passed (4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed, `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed.
- No file under `testdata/` changed. No importer code changed.

Pre-existing failure, not caused by this PR: `plunge_depth_tab::the_tabbed_contour_catalog_case_names_its_tab_window_dives` fails with "three tab window dives named: []". It fails in the same way on bare `upstream/main`. The #3678 pecking removed the dives that the #3679 test expects. #3920 (main is red) tracks it. This PR does not touch tab code: control and wear compensation refuse tabs.

Targeted heavy step (P1, safety floor): no `#[ignore]`d test covers `contour_comp.rs` or the comp suites. There is no heavy step to run.

### Mutations (in the review worktree only, then reverted)

1. Disable the new `Lead::Linear` refusal in `door` (`if false && matches!(...)`). Red: `machining2d::a_linear_lead_under_control_or_wear_is_refused_by_name_on_both_sides`. The path dives at `(21, -5)`, on the radius 5 ring line.
2. Keep the refusal disabled, and set the app fixture lead in `crates/app/tests/control_comp.rs:58` back to `Linear`. Red: `the_entry_descents_before_g41_hold_the_wall_clear_under_an_oversized_register_and_positive_wear` ("Control Plunge: the closest pre-G41 stand is 3.162 mm off the wall"). Also red: `a_linear_lead_in_or_out_under_control_or_wear_is_refused_and_posts_nothing` and the two golden tests.

After the revert, `machining2d` (75) and app `control_comp` (9) are green again.

### Optional, non-blocking

- The notes of the earlier review stay as follow-ups: `crates/app/tests/control_comp.rs` is 495 lines, and no structural test pins the new consequence text.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Ready for merge from the merge loop: collaborator review 5dbe2228 at head 5dbe2228d7586a36e4f1adc394f4414357fb5318.
